sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: Postal Service has been in the news a lot recently because horrible people are trying to damage it.
sentences.zh: 邮政服务最近经常登上新闻，因为一些混蛋正试图破坏它。

sentences.en: And what makes me particularly upset about this is that the Postal Service is just the beSt.
sentences.zh: 而对此让我感到尤其沮丧的是，邮政服务简直太棒了。

sentences.en: I was always a fan, but I became evangelical after reading Winifred Gallagher's book, How the Post Office Created America.
sentences.zh: 我一直是个粉丝，但在读了温妮弗雷德·加拉格尔的书《邮局是如何创造美国的》之后，我成了它的狂热信徒。

sentences.en: We did an episode with Gallagher a couple years ago, and even though I'm supposed to be actually taking a week off,
sentences.zh: 几年前我们和加拉格尔做过一期节目，尽管我本该真正休假一周，

sentences.en: it seemed like a good idea to get this out in the world again.
sentences.zh: 但把这期节目重新发布似乎是个不错的主意。

sentences.en: The Postal Service is critical to our way of life, and it always has been.
sentences.zh: 邮政服务对我们的生活方式至关重要，而且一直如此。

sentences.en: And so here's 20 minutes of us telling you amazing stories about how great the USPS is.
sentences.zh: 所以，接下来是20分钟的内容，我们向你讲述一些精彩的故事，告诉你USPS有多伟大。

sentences.en: There are currently more than 31,000 post offices in the United States.
There are grand old ones that take up entire city blocks, and there are smaller, humbler ones
sentences.zh: 有占据整条街区的大型历史悠久的老邮局，也有更小、更简陋的邮局，

sentences.en: hiding away in the backs of general stores in towns across rural America.
sentences.zh: 它们隐藏在全美乡村小镇的小卖部后面。

sentences.en: But this one in Arizona may be the most rural post office in the continental U.S.
sentences.zh: 但亚利桑那州的这家邮局可能是美国本土最偏远的邮局。

sentences.en: The Supai Post Office is located at the bottom of the Grand Canyon.
sentences.zh: 苏帕伊邮局位于大峡谷底部。

sentences.en: My name is Vivian Campbell, and I am the Postmaster of Peach Springs, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 我叫维维安·坎贝尔，我是亚利桑那州桃泉镇的邮政局长。

sentences.en: Vivian works closely with the Supai Post Office, and she says there are only a few ways to get mail to the bottom of the Grand Canyon.
sentences.zh: 维维安与苏帕伊邮局密切合作，她说要把信件送到大峡谷底部只有几种方法。

sentences.en: You either have to hike down there, ride a mule, or ride a horse.
sentences.zh: 你要么得徒步走下去，要么骑骡子，要么骑马。

sentences.en: And so, every day, rain or shine, mail gets packed on 10 mules to make a two-and-a-half-hour trip into the canyon.
sentences.zh: 因此，每天风雨无阻，邮件都会打包驮在10头骡子上，开启进入大峡谷的两个半小时行程。

sentences.en: The post office is there to serve the people who live on the Avasupai Reservation.
sentences.zh: 这个邮局的存在是为了服务住在哈瓦苏派保留地的人们。

sentences.en: Avasupai meaning blue-green water people, named for the waterfall at the bottom of the canyon.
sentences.zh: 哈瓦苏派意为蓝绿色水的人们，因峡谷底部的瀑布而得名。

sentences.en: The water is so blue, it's not even, it's indescribable.
sentences.zh: 水是那么蓝，甚至无法形容，简直难以言表。

sentences.en: The Avasupai receive a lot of food supplies, but otherwise, their mail is pretty standard fare.
sentences.zh: 哈瓦苏派收到了很多食品物资，但除此之外，他们的邮件就相当普通了。

sentences.en: They get packages from Amazon, they get first-class mail, they get bills just like you and me.
sentences.zh: 他们收到亚马逊的包裹，收到一等邮件，就像你我一样收到账单。

sentences.en: The Supai Post Office was established in 1896, and its existence speaks to the lengths that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 苏帕伊邮局建立于1896年，它的存在彰显了美国

sentences.en: Post Office has gone to connect people with each other,
sentences.zh: 邮政为将人们彼此联系起来所付出的巨大努力，

sentences.en: and to unite us as a country, ever since the service was founded in the late 1700s.
sentences.zh: 并且自从18世纪后期邮政服务创立以来，就将我们作为一个国家团结在一起。

sentences.en: I was sitting on my back porch in Wyoming one night, you know, as the sun sank in the Golden West,
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，我坐在怀俄明州的后廊上，你知道的，正如太阳在金色的西方落下，

sentences.en: and I just jumped up out of the chair and, like, shrieked at my husband.
sentences.zh: 我突然从椅子上跳起来，冲我丈夫尖叫。

sentences.en: That is author and historian Winifred Gallagher, and she wrote a book based on this revelation called, appropriately,

sentences.en: How the Post Office Created America, a History.
sentences.zh: 《邮局是如何创造美国的：一部历史》。

sentences.en: Gallagher argues that the post office didn't just create an efficient and inexpensive way to send a letter from Oakland, California, into the Grand Canyon.
sentences.zh: 加拉格尔认为，邮局不仅创造了一种高效且便宜的方式，能把一封信从加利福尼亚州奥克兰寄到大峡谷里。

sentences.en: The service was designed to unite a bunch of disparate towns and people under one flag.
sentences.zh: 这项服务的旨在将一群散漫的城镇和人民团结在同一面旗帜下。

sentences.en: And in doing so, the post office actually created the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，邮局实际上创造了美利坚合众国。

sentences.en: For thousands of years, governments have had ways of sending information across distances.
sentences.zh: 几千年来，各国政府都有跨距离传递信息的方法。

sentences.en: But for most of history, the mail was limited to correspondence between governments, militaries,
sentences.zh: 但在大部分历史中，邮件仅限于政府、军队之间的通信，

sentences.en: and eventually, wealthy people who could afford to pay for such a service.
sentences.zh: 以及最终那些能够负担得起这种服务费用的富人。

sentences.en: And that's what the postal system of early colonized America was like.
sentences.zh: 早期殖民地时期的美国邮政系统就是这样。

sentences.en: The Crown's Post was put in place by the English monarchy,
sentences.zh: 皇家邮政由英国君主建立，

sentences.en: and was mostly used to get messages from England to America.
sentences.zh: 主要用于将信息从英国传送到美洲。

sentences.en: Once the mail landed from England into America, it would be circulated by a fellow called a post rider,
sentences.zh: 一旦邮件从英国运抵美洲，就会由一个叫邮差的家伙进行分发，

sentences.en: who, just like he sounds, he was a man on a horse.

sentences.en: As postmaster, Franklin was in charge of making sure mail in the colonies got to its proper location,

他实际上访问了每一个殖民地。

sentences.zh: 他设立了里程碑，这样你就可以根据信件行程的距离公平收费，
